result:
Lint is clean across every touched file. The implementation is complete:

**Summary of changes:**
- `src/types/organization.ts` — added `OwnershipHandoverStatus` and `OwnershipHandover`.
- `src/lib/errors.ts` — added `OwnershipHandoverError`/`OwnershipHandoverRefusal`, wired into `isDomainError`/`toAppError` (→ `conflict`).
- `src/types/event.ts` — added `organization.ownership_transferred` to `TaskflowEventMap`.
- `src/types/notification.ts`, `src/schemas/notification.ts`, `src/server/db/schema/notifications.ts`, `notification-preferences-form.tsx` — added the `ownership_handover` notification kind.
- `src/types/activity.ts`, `src/schemas/activity.ts`, `activity-labels.ts` — added the `organization.ownership_transferred` audit action.
- `src/types/permission.ts`, `src/lib/permissions.ts` — added `org:transfer_ownership` (role floor `owner`, used only for the `PermissionDeniedError` shape — the actual gate is recorded ownership, not role rank).
- New `src/server/db/schema/ownership-handovers.ts` table, exported from the schema barrel, plus the matching `CREATE TABLE`/indexes in `migrate.ts`'s fallback SQL so a fresh migration has it.
- New `src/server/repositories/ownership-handover-repository.ts` (insert/find-open/resolve) and a `toOwnershipHandover` mapper; `organization-repository.ts` gained `updateOwner`.
- `src/server/services/organization-service.ts` — the five required exports, plus `registerOwnershipHandoverListeners` (auto-withdraws on `member.removed`), all guarded per spec: recorded-owner-only offer/withdraw (`PermissionDeniedError`), `self`/`pending_exists`/`nothing_pending`/`expired` refusals, lazy expiry, correct promote-then-demote ordering so the workspace never lacks an owner, and `notify(...)`/`emit("organization.ownership_transferred", ...)` on acceptance.
- `src/server/services/activity-service.ts` and `event-registry.ts` — wired the new event/listener into the existing audit and bus-registration patterns.

Verified with the full existing test suite (617 tests, unchanged pass rate), `tsc`/`next typegen`, `eslint`, and a throwaway end-to-end smoke test (removed afterward) covering offer/accept/decline/withdraw, permission edge cases, expiry, notifications, audit logging, and removal-triggered auto-withdraw.
